turns.question: At which hour of the day were the most page views recorded between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many page views were in that hour?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no hourly breakdown, so I cannot say which hour had the most page views; the closest metric is Site sessions (sessions with a page view), which is available by day only, and its highest day in 20 September to 3 October 2026 was 2026-10-01 with 5 sessions. Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
